_comment: Canonical frontend MCP server bundle — the single source of truth for scripts/ensure-frontend-mcp.js, which merges these into a frontend project's own .mcp.json (project scope) so they auto-load there. Demoted from GLOBAL user scope on 2026-05-28 (jazzy-wren audit) to cut global tool-surface/picker bloat while keeping them available exactly where they're used. To re-globalize any one: claude mcp add -s user <name> -- npx ...
